marks.gloss_en: דאמר שמואל: אסור לגנוב דעת הבריות ואפילו דעתו של גוי (no SupportKind names an amoraic dictum adduced with ד-)
ואי בעית אימא משום דקא גניב ליה לדעתיה (= p_taam_geneivat_daat)
stam: [a cut thigh is forbidden] because he deceives him
לאו בפירוש איתמר, אלא מכללא איתמר -- inferred from Shmuel's anger at the ferry (kind svara: no support kind names an inference from a maaseh)
Shmuel was crossing in a ferry; he told his attendant to compensate the ferryman; he did, and Shmuel was angry
וכי מכללא מאי? למאן דאמר טרפה הואי -- אמר ליה: אמאי תשהא איסורא? -- per Abaye, the anger may have been at keeping a forbidden thing
למאן דאמר אנפקא אמר ליה לאשקויי -- אנפקא חייא משמע: per Rava, the anger may have been at disobeying the instruction for undiluted wine
ומעשה באחד ששיגר... וחנק את עצמו (kind svara stands in for a maaseh adduced for a rule)
the baraita: one may not send another a barrel of wine with oil floating on top
ומעשה באחד שזמן שלשה אורחין... (kind svara stands in for a maaseh adduced for a rule)
the baraita's incident: in years of drought the three guests each gave the host's son his share; the father found him and struck him dead; the mother and then the father fell from the roof and died
אילימא במקום שאין מכריזין -- חתוכה נמי לישדר ליה, דהא לא אתו למזבן מיניה: if it is a place that does not announce, Jews do not buy from gentiles, so a cut thigh too should be sendable

אלא במקום שמכריזין -- שלימה נמי לא לישדר ליה, דחתיך ליה ומזבין ליה: in a place that announces, Jews buy from gentiles when nothing is announced, so even a whole thigh should not be sent -- he will cut it and sell it
ואיבעית אימא במקום שאין מכריזין -- גזירה שמא יתננה לו בפני ישראל אחר (= p_gzeira_bifnei_yisrael)
stam: in a place that does not announce, [a cut thigh is forbidden by] a decree lest he give it to him in front of another Jew
איבעית אימא במקום שמכריזין -- חיתוכא דגוי מידע ידיע (= p_chituch_goy_nikar)
stam: in a place that announces, a gentile's cutting is recognisable
איני? והא עולא איקלע לבי רב יהודה, פתח לו חביות המכורות לחנווני
אודועי אודעיה -- he told him
ואיבעית אימא: שאני עולא דחביב ליה לרב יהודה, דבלאו הכי נמי מפתח הוה פתח ליה -- Ulla was dear to him; he would have opened them for him anyway
Ulla came to Rav Yehuda's house, and he opened for him barrels sold to a shopkeeper
Abaye: it was a tereifa chicken, and he gave it to him as [if it were] slaughtered
R' Meir: one may not press another to dine with him knowing he will not dine
R' Meir: nor open for him barrels sold to a shopkeeper unless he told him
the baraita: one may not go to a mourner's house holding a rattling jug, nor fill it with water, because he misleads him
the baraita: one may not sell another a sandal from a carcass as [from] a slaughtered animal
the baraita: guests may not give of what is before them to the host's son or daughter without the host's permission
R' Eliezer b. Yaakov: over this matter three souls of Israel were killed
the baraita: one who sends a thigh to his fellow -- whole, he need not remove the sciatic nerve
the baraita: for two reasons they said one may not sell carcasses and tereifot to a gentile -- he misleads him, and lest he resell it to another Jew
the baraita: one may not tell a gentile 'buy me meat with this dinar', for two reasons -- the oppressors, and lest they sell him carcasses and tereifot
